REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JUNE 10, 2021 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 832 9681 0948
LEGISLATIVE BODY MEMBERS AND THE PUBLIC MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, OR VIA TELECONFERENCE AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current Los Angeles County Health Officer Order, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public subject to Los Angeles County mandated COVID-19 protocols. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 this meeting will also be conducted via teleconference. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below, or in-person subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using any of the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83296810948
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 832 9681 0948
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

5.

5A. Review and consideration of the 2021-22 Mayor's annual appointment recommendations for City Councilmember service on internal and external committees (COUNCIL).
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for comments related to the Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and/or items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the legislative body. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.
7.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the legislative body, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a legislative body member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
7A.
Approval of Minutes
Thursday, May 27, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).
Thursday, June 3, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
Thursday, June 3, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY) (Revised)
7B.
Approval of Registers of Demands
7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated June 10, 2021 (COUNCIL).
7C.
Approval of Treasurer's Reports
City Council/Successor Agency Treasurer's Reports for the period ending April 30, 2021 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).
8.
Public Hearings
9.
New and Old Business
9A. Review and consideration of an informational update on the City's response to the COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).
9B. Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADOPTING A LIST OF PROJECTS TO BE FUNDED BY SENATE BILL 1: ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT FUNDS, FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 (COUNCIL).
9C. Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING A GENERAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES (COUNCIL).
10.
Legislative Items
10A.
Report on pending legislation.
10B.
Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.
11.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
12.
Closed Session

Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
Title: City Manager

Closed Session Report
After the City Council/Successor Agency reconvenes into Open Session, designated City staff will provide a verbal report on any reportable action taken in Closed Session. This report will be memorialized in the official meeting minutes.
13.
Adjournment

  committees to take the positions very seriously for the betterment of the City and its
  residents.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.
